node.title: Re^2: Add values to subroutine inside of a loop.
node.author: Anonymous Monk
node.doctext: Yes, it overwrites the last key,value, but this is what I am trying to accomplish: $success = sent( { to => 'send_to', account => 'to_account', name => 'name', subject => 'subject', title => 'title', link => "/var/www/docs", name => "mydocs", link => "/var/www/read", name => "letters", type => 'docs', });
